about.title: Efe İnşaat: A Success Story Built on Trust
about.intro: Rooted in quality and reliability, Efe İnşaat does more than build—we craft lasting living spaces. Across Ataşehir and Istanbul we deliver PVC windows, glass balconies, pergolas, and insect-screen solutions with clear communication, professional workmanship, and a promise we stand behind.

about.storyTitle: From structure to finish—the same care
storyParagraphs: What began as carefully executed installations grew into a reputation for trust. From **residential homes to commercial buildings**, renovations to custom designs, we keep one principle: the right materials, the right craftsmanship, the right conversation.

Across PVC windows, glass balconies, bioclimatic pergolas, and plissé screens, **customer satisfaction** must last beyond handover—into years of daily use. That is why every installation is judged by long-term performance.

By combining innovative construction technologies with field experience, we simplify the journey—with transparent proposals and a **free site survey** that makes decisions easier. For us, success is not square meters completed; it is a partnership people recommend with confidence.
about.quote: Trust is not a slogan—it is a responsibility earned again with every measurement and every install.

cam-balkon.intro: Sliding and folding glass balcony systems turn your balcony into a living space you can use year-round.
body: Glass balconies protect open balconies from wind, rain, and dust while expanding usable space. At Efe İnşaat we provide measurement, fabrication, and installation for sliding and folding glass balcony systems across Ataşehir and Istanbul.
Insulated-glass options help you use the balcony more comfortably in winter. Contact us for a free survey and a clear quote matched to your project.
cam-balkon.ctaDescription: Request a free survey—we'll recommend a suitable model and prepare a clear price quote.
cam-balkon.relatedSubtitle: Explore other systems that complete your living spaces.

pergole.intro: Aluminum, wood-look, and bioclimatic pergola systems turn terraces and gardens into shaded, usable outdoor rooms.
body: Pergola systems provide controlled shade and weather protection for terraces, gardens, and outdoor seating. Efe İnşaat delivers aluminum, wood-look, and bioclimatic pergola projects with professional installation.
Bioclimatic pergolas use adjustable louvers to control light and airflow. Motorized options can be operated by remote. Reach out for survey and pricing.
pergole.ctaDescription: We'll help choose the right pergola for your terrace or garden—with a free survey and clear pricing.
pergole.relatedSubtitle: Discover our other outdoor and facade solutions.

pimapen.intro: Insulated PVC window and door systems create comfortable, energy-efficient living spaces.
body: PVC window and door systems (often called pimapen in Turkey) offer thermal and acoustic comfort with long service life. Efe İnşaat provides custom measurement, fabrication, and professional installation in Ataşehir and Istanbul.
With proper care, quality PVC systems can serve for many years. Request a free survey for new installs or window replacements.
pimapen.ctaDescription: Request a free survey for your window and door needs—clear pricing and model guidance included.
pimapen.relatedSubtitle: Explore our balcony and facade systems as well.

sineklik.intro: Pleated, sliding, and hinged insect screens keep bugs out while letting fresh air in.
body: Insect screens protect windows and doors from insects without blocking ventilation. Efe İnşaat installs pleated, sliding, and hinged screen systems with accurate on-site measurement.
Standard window screens are often measured and installed the same day. Door screens and special systems may take longer depending on the model. Contact us for pricing and installation details.
sineklik.ctaDescription: Request free measurement and pricing for window or door insect screens.
sineklik.relatedSubtitle: Also explore PVC windows, glass balconies, and pergolas.

items.question: How long do PVC windows last?
items.answer: Quality PVC window systems can serve trouble-free for 25-30 years under proper care and usage conditions. This period can be extended even further with regular maintenance.

items.question: Do glass balcony systems provide adequate protection in winter?
items.answer: Glass balcony systems provide effective protection against wind, rain, and dust. With double-glazed options, you can comfortably use your balcony during winter months as well.

items.question: What is a bioclimatic pergola?
items.answer: A bioclimatic pergola is a smart shading system that allows you to control sunlight and air circulation with its movable louver structure. Motorized versions can be controlled with a remote.

items.question: How long does insect screen installation take?
items.answer: For standard window insect screens, measurement and installation are usually completed within the same day. Time may vary for door screens and special systems.

items.question: Do you provide free site inspection?
items.answer: Yes, we offer free site inspection and price quotation for all our services. You can reach us by email or through the contact form.

items.question: What is the warranty period?
items.answer: We provide a minimum 2-year workmanship warranty on all our products and services. Product warranties range from 5-10 years depending on the brand.
